correctness.rationale: Kummer and the odd denominator reduce valuations exactly to binary addition carries. Four states with two digit transitions and an exact terminal carry supply the matrix identity for all r. The computed determinant and adjugate numerator give the rational generating function, so the degree-three recurrence is exact. The first-carry argument rules out valuation one; carry bounds and witnesses \(n=2^j-1\) prove exact support. Complete independent dyadic digit enumerations through r=16 and 384 large-integer checks passed; these finite checks are corroboration only.
